outputs: multilingual textual answers to visual questions
Free-form text answers generated by models for visual questions.
The models generate answers to visual questions in multilingual settings, which constitutes natural language generation.

changes_made.explanation: Normalized language ISO codes to full names and model names for consistency. Added fine-tuned models LLaVA1.5-7B-CML-SFT and Qwen2-VL-7B-CML-SFT mentioned in ablation analysis. Removed redundant/clarifying output descriptions. Unified model name variations.
Normalized metric names by simplifying variants (CBA for Custom Binary Accuracy, vtS for Visual-Textual Similarity) and using canonical form for Accuracy. Removed redundant full names.
No LLM-as-judge usage detected; metadata correctly empty.

guideline: Native speakers provide reference answers for scoring model outputs via automatic metrics
Annotators generate five unique and relevant questions per image, with answers grounded in image text
Second group of annotators re-answers questions and flags discrepancies for adjudication
Third-party reviewers address ambiguous questions via 'raise-then-correct' evaluation

overall_notes: The paper focuses on Text-Centric Visual Question Answering (TEC-VQA) as an NLG task where models generate multilingual text answers. Extractions were mostly accurate but required normalization of language codes, model names, and metrics. Human evaluation metadata was expanded to fully capture the three-stage annotation pipeline. No LLM-as-judge usage was found.
